data.one_liner: Check whether an email address uses a valid or disposable domain name.
data.what_it_does: Provides methods to validate email address formats, extract and normalize domains, and check if an email uses a known disposable or temporary email service. Features optimized O(1) domain lookups with a built-in list of over 3,200 domains.
use_when: You want to prevent users from registering with temporary or disposable email addresses.
You need RFC 5322 compliant email format validation alongside disposable domain checks.
avoid_when: You need to verify the email box actually exists by sending an email or performing an MX record lookup.
strengths: Fast O(1) set-based lookups for disposable domains
Provides detailed validation results including format checks and error messages
Comprehensive null safety and whitespace handling
weaknesses: Relies on a static built-in list of disposable domains which may require package updates to catch newly created temporary email providers
